idea-plugin.name: Stranger Theme
idea-plugin.description:
Stranger Theme

A dark theme collection inspired by the famous series Stranger Things.

Includes six theme variants based on iconic elements from the show:

  • Upside Down: Dark blue-black with desaturated tones
  • Starcourt Mall: Vibrant 80s mall aesthetic with neon colors
  • Hawkins: Small-town America with warm, muted, autumnal colors
  • The Lab: Clinical, institutional aesthetic with sterile colors
  • Tigers: School colors with orange/black and vintage academic tones
  • Dimension X: Fleshy pinks/reds with dark, organic textures
idea-plugin.change-notes: • 1.0.0 - Initial release with six theme variants
